title: lunch-plans
text:
lunch-plans

sam: Flying out early Friday — any SFO grab-and-go recs? Gate A-ish. Need coffee + something breakfast-y before 6am.

maya: Terminal 2 Blue Bottle opens at 5am, solid pour and pastries. :+1:

kevin: Boudin in T3 opens ~4:30 and has hearty breakfast sandwiches and soups if you want something filling.

olivia: If you want to avoid terminal lines, 'Market Pocket' near 101 Market (5-min walk from the office) has great to-go sandwiches and pre-packed fruit. Opens 5:30.

jessica: For a quick sit-down in SoMa try Bright Morn on 3rd — speedy service, great veggie options. Avocado toast + coffee typically under $12.

sam: Awesome — I'm actually at gate A, any tips on getting to T2 early without stress?

kevin: SFO AirTrain between terminals is fast but allow ~10–15m for transfer + security. If you have PreCheck/CLEAR that helps a lot.

olivia: Pro tip: ask Blue Bottle to heat a croissant in a foil sleeve — makes it way better for plane. :croissant:

flight-bot: Reminder: check-in opens 24h before departure. Typical boarding starts 30–45m before departure.

sam: Good call. I'll pick up Blue Bottle and a granola bar just in case. Thanks everyone! :sunglasses:

kevin: Quick reference:

```text
T2: Blue Bottle — opens 5:00
T3: Boudin — opens 4:30
A gates: small espresso kiosk — ≈5:15
```

jessica: Safe travels! Send a pic of the croissant. :camera_with_flash:
